summary: Phase-1 canvas upgrades (Saved Layouts + Inline Roadmap Authoring) tested end-to-end: 14/14 new backend tests pass, all 12 UI acceptance criteria verified. Backend: GET/PUT /organizations/{id}/framework-layout works, require_write enforced (viewer→403), shared per company (editor sees owner's saves), distinct per org (Vertex independent of Northwind), reset writes empty overrides, publish() includes payload.layout snapshot. Frontend (owner <owner-email>): fc-arrange-toggle shows handles; dragging fc-drag-sec-C shows fc-layout-bar with fc-save-layout enabled; save → success; reload persists via GET; reset clears overrides. fc-add-sales-1 creates initiative with data.area='sales', data.phase=1 and opens drawer titled 'New initiative'. dtab-Roadmap present; rm-dep-add picker links 'Lead Qualification Agent' as removable chip (depends_on relationship created); rm-acc-text/rm-acc-add persist in data.acceptance_items; rm-adopt-text/rm-adopt-add persist (default 'assigned'); rm-adopt-<id> cycles states; roadmap cell renders a ◷ marker on the new initiative confirming incomplete adoption indicator (visible in screenshot). Quick fields saved → data.owner, data.status, data.deliverable, data.target_date all persisted after reload. Viewer (viewer@bots.demo): fc-arrange-toggle absent, fc-drag-sec-C absent, fc-fit-all still present (pan/zoom + record open still work). Regression: all 4 sections render, fit controls work, zoom works, secondary views load.

issues: Dev-build injects <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <option> elements, triggering a React 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning. Likely a dev-tooling (ve) artifact rather than production code, but noisy in console. Consider rendering dep options as plain text (no component wrapping) to silence.

action_items: (Minor) Decide whether roadmap-tab 'Owner' field should map to data.human_owner (consistent with agents elsewhere) or stay as data.owner (initiative-only). Current code uses data.owner, which is fine but worth documenting.
(Minor) Silence <span> inside <option> hydration warning from dev tooling or render dep options without wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: Framework layout GET exposes overrides to any reader (require_read) — correct per spec ('shared per company'). Write path uses require_write — viewer correctly blocked.
publish() reads layouts collection once and stores overrides into snapshot payload.layout — correct and verified by test_snapshot_captures_layout.

Field naming inconsistency: agents use data.human_owner, roadmap tab writes data.owner. Minor but could cause confusion when the same entity's Overview vs Roadmap tabs show different owner-ish fields.
No DELETE endpoint for entities — tests must use POST /entities/{id}/archive?confirm=true. Not a bug; just worth remembering for future test authors.
RoadmapTab saveData does optimistic concurrency correctly (reads ent.version each save) — safe for rapid chip edits.
test_credentials: from env: ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD / DEMO_USERS_PASSWORD (values never stored in the repo)
seed_data_creation: Created and then archived test initiative 51727cb01071a29b27dc7b98 in o-northwind sales/phase1 ('New initiative'). Northwind layout reset to empty overrides at end. Backend tests publish an extra Northwind snapshot (TEST_layout snapshot) — expected and matches prior iteration's publish test behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To POST a relationship use fields {from_id, to_id, rel_type} (NOT from_entity/to_entity/relation_type). To delete an entity use POST /entities/{id}/archive?confirm=true (no DELETE route). Canvas uses CSS transform; use page.evaluate(() => el.click()) to activate hidden fc-add-<area>-<phase> + buttons which rely on group-hover opacity. The ◷ marker on roadmap chips indicates adoption_items present with any state != 'accepted'. Note: data.owner for initiatives, data.human_owner for agents.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. All review-request assertions passed.
